design.py.description: Corrected ALU design. All 8 operations must produce correct 4-bit unsigned results for every input pair (a, b in 0..15). The build_alu(opcode, a, b) interface and opcode-to-operation mapping must remain unchanged. Subsidiary functions may be modified as needed.

analysis.py.description: Circuit graph analysis module operating on the HDL framework's Wire/Bus representation.

required_exports.count_gates(outputs): Given a Bus of output wires, return the count of unique logic gate nodes (AND, OR, XOR, NOT) reachable in the circuit. Constants and primary inputs are not counted as gates.
required_exports.critical_path(outputs): Given a Bus of output wires, return the longest chain of dependent gate operations from any primary input to any output. Primary inputs and constants have depth 0; each gate adds 1.
required_exports.max_fanout(outputs): Given a Bus of output wires, return the maximum number of gate inputs driven by any single wire in the reachable circuit. Measures how many downstream gates consume a given wire as an input.

fast_alu.py.description: Optimized ALU variant with improved propagation delay.

required_exports.fast_adder(a, b, cin): A 4-bit adder (Bus a, Bus b, Wire cin) returning (Bus sum, Wire carry_out). Must produce correct results for all 512 input combinations and have strictly shorter critical path than the adder in design.py.
required_exports.build_alu_fast(opcode, a, b): Complete ALU (Bus opcode, Bus a, Bus b) returning Bus result. Uses the fast adder for arithmetic. Must implement all 8 operations with correct behavior matching the corrected design.py.

item_fields.function: string — name of the buggy function
item_fields.description: string — what was wrong and its observable effect

schema.evaluation: string — minimum 80 characters comparing the two architectures across area, delay, and wiring complexity tradeoffs

constraints: optimized.critical_path_depth must be strictly less than original.critical_path_depth
